whoTheyAre.summary: The live PeopleGroups.org record identifies Chechens in the Russian Federation and ties the record to Chechen (che). Independent linguistic sources place Chechen in the Nakh-Daghestanian/Nakh context, while legal and literary sources document formal language status and contemporary Chechen-language cultural production without implying one political identity.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG024428 reports PEID 24428, display name Chechens, country Russian Federation and primary language Chechen (che).

Glottolog identifies Chechen with glottocode chec1245 and ISO 639-3 code che; North Caucasian linguistic reference work places Chechen in the Nakh branch of the wider North Caucasian language context.

Formal language policy and recent literary scholarship document institutional and literary use of Chechen; together they show a living language context without implying a uniform political or cultural identity among Chechens.
claims.interpretationNote: Language law and literary production are institutional/cultural context only; they are not evidence of individual political affiliation, security history or personal identity.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports Islam - Sunni as the aggregate primary-religion label for PG024428.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider classification for one people-group-in-country record, not a statement about every Chechen person's belief or practice.
